key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to check for new releases (in seconds). Default is 1800 (30 minutes).

key.name: icon-position
key.description: Where to display the icon on the panel: left, center, or right

key.name: release-monitoring-api-token
key.description: API token for release-monitoring.org to bypass bot protection. Get your token from https://release-monitoring.org/settings/

key.name: rhel-cdn-cert-path
key.description: Path to the Red Hat entitlement client certificate (.pem). Leave empty to auto-detect under ~/.config/release-monitor/certs/

key.name: rhel-cdn-key-path
key.description: Path to the Red Hat entitlement private key (-key.pem). Leave empty to auto-detect under ~/.config/release-monitor/certs/

key.name: rhel-cdn-ca-path
key.description: Path to redhat-uep.pem. Leave empty to use ~/.config/release-monitor/certs/redhat-uep.pem when present.
